behavioral.label: Open Chat CTA button
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls onOpenChat which is wired in App.tsx:1059 to () => navigateTo('chat') — pure local navigation, no backend needed.

behavioral.label: Customize dashboard toggle
behavioral.evidence: onClick toggles customizeMode local state; when toggled off also closes pickerOpen. Pure local state change, persists via useLocalStorage.

behavioral.label: Add widget button
behavioral.evidence: onClick toggles pickerOpen local state. WidgetPickerDrawer then calls handleAddWidget -> addWidgetToLayout -> persistDashboardLayout. Fully wired.

behavioral.label: Reset to default button
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls handleResetLayout -> resetDashboardLayout -> persistDashboardLayout. Fully wired local state + localStorage.

behavioral.label: Stream filter buttons (all/validated/in-progress/doubted/speculative)
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls setFilterKind (prop from App.tsx). Filters in-memory stream array. Pure local state.

behavioral.label: Immersive View link (Workspace Simulation Mini-Map)
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls onNavigate?.('gamify'). onNavigate is wired in App.tsx:1058 to navigateTo. Works as navigation.

behavioral.label: Collapse/Expand button (Workspace Simulation Mini-Map)
behavioral.evidence: onClick toggles sandboxCollapsed local state. Pure local state.

behavioral.label: Pause/Resume agent button
behavioral.evidence: onClick routes to onPause/onResume. App.tsx:898/910: handlePause/handleResume call executeIpcWithRun('pause_orchestrator_agent'/'resume_orchestrator_agent', {agentId}). Real Tauri invoke backed by optimistic local state update.

behavioral.label: Open in Console button
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls onOpenInConsole(a). App.tsx:1060: wired to navigateTo('console') with agent selection. Pure navigation.

behavioral.label: Approve button (inline approval)
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls onApprove(pendingApprovalId). In Dashboard.tsx:229 wired to approvals.resolve(id, 'approved'). useAgentApprovals.resolve calls voxTransport.invokeMcpTool('vox_resolve_approval', {approval_id, outcome:'approved'}).

behavioral.label: Reject button (inline approval)
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls onReject(pendingApprovalId). Wired to approvals.resolve(id, 'rejected'). Same MCP path as Approve.

behavioral.label: Doubt button on StreamCard
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls onDoubt?.(item). onDoubt is defined as optional on Dashboard props (line 48) but is NOT passed from App.tsx (no handleDoubt exists in App.tsx). The optional chaining ?. silently no-ops. The button renders and is visible but has zero effect.

behavioral.label: Overrule button on StreamCard
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls onOverrule?.(item). onOverrule is defined as optional on Dashboard props (line 49) but is NOT passed from App.tsx (no handleOverrule exists). The ?. silently no-ops. Button appears on hover for doubted items but does nothing.

behavioral.label: Acknowledge alert (X) button
behavioral.evidence: onClick calls onAck(note). Wired in App.tsx:1051 to handleAckAlert, which calls invoke('ack_ludus_notification', {notificationId}) and optimistically removes from local state.

visual.issue: Hardcoded hex color bg-[#09090b]/80 used for Workspace Simulation Mini-Map background instead of a ds-token (e.g. bg-bg-base/80).
text-amber-300 used directly for the alert icon in the Alerts widget header; should use a semantic token like text-status-warn.
Budget burn bar uses raw Tailwind colors bg-rose-400 / bg-amber-400 / bg-emerald-400 for threshold states instead of semantic tokens (text-status-fail / text-status-warn / text-status-pass).

toneMap uses raw Tailwind gradient colors (from-emerald-400/40, from-brass/40, from-amber-400/40, from-violet-400/40) for the left-accent bar; no ds-tokens for status colors exist for gradient stops, but emerald/amber/violet bypasses the token system.
Doubt button hover uses hover:border-amber-400/30 hover:text-amber-300; Overrule button uses border-amber-400/20 bg-amber-400/5 text-amber-300. All direct Tailwind color references without ds-tokens.
stylingMap uses raw emerald-400/300, amber-400/300, cyan-400/300, rose-400/300 for ring/bg/text in all four alert level variants. Should use semantic status tokens.

'Immersive View' link is a plain <button> with only text content — no aria-label needed here, but the 'Collapse'/'Expand' button (line 369) likewise has only text, so both are fine on their own. However the section header uses a Unicode bullet ⬤ (line 366) inside a <span> with no aria-hidden='true', which will be read aloud as 'black circle' by screen readers.

The 'Immersive View' button (text-cyan class, line 368) is styled with an arbitrary text-cyan class. If that resolves to a Tailwind cyan color rather than a ds-token, it is both a ds-token violation and potentially insufficient contrast on dark backgrounds.

Doubt and Overrule action buttons are opacity-0 by default and only appear on group-hover. Since onDoubt and onOverrule are both dead (not wired from App.tsx), these hidden controls provide false affordance — they appear interactive but have no effect.

Customize dashboard controls (absolute top-right, z-20) overlap the KPI row and AttentionBudgetMeter on narrower viewports since the KPIs and meter have no right-side clearance accounting for the absolutely-positioned button cluster.
